t:
"Never give your love away," the Kanians say. Why, but of course you can trust a best friend with your mount! Enter your stable, choose a mount you would like to lend and share it! If your best friend has an empty slot, the mount you have chosen will gallop right into it, and all their Incarnations will be able to ride it as well! It's just as easy to return it, you only need to open the stable.
There are, however, two restrictions. First, a mount whose rank is 5 or higher is faithful to you, so make sure to share only mounts of ranks 1 to 4. Second, color patterns belong to you and cannot be shared.

Who may you safely lend your Astral ship? Why, your best friend, of course! Enter the hangar together, summon your ship and lend it to your best friend. The things they can do to the ship are the same as you can do: summon, undock from hangars, travel to Astral isles, enter battles, take damage and repair it. One thing they are unable to perform, is changing your ship's devices.
You cannot summon your ship while your best friend is holding it. To get it back, you have to enter the hangar together once again and ask for it. The ship will automatically return to you once your friendship is over.
Bear in mind, that all cargo on the ship will disappear as soon as your best friend gets hold of your ship!
Once a half an hour you may teleport to each other, provided that you both are not in combat. When you're done, you may teleport back to your initial location.

Normally two heroes with a significant difference in levels cannot go down to the same dungeon or Astral Isle. This rule does not affect best friends. However, the stronger best friend is not able to just smash the enemy. Instead, they cover their best friend's back and support them. The little one thus obtains five new abilities: one increases damage, another protects from enemies' spells, the third one heals, the fourth one casts fear on the enemy, and the last one teleports the party to the dungeon entrance, just like Mage's Sanctuary. Best friends can invite other heroes to their party, but the stronger best friend's abilities do not apply to them.

I am the official representative of the Free Traders in Nezebgrad. According to my contract with the City Council, I have an exclusive right to buy up and resell valuables obtained in the Astral, Distortions, and Skirmishes.

You can become my regular customer, but with one condition. The great leader Yasker encourages all heroes to unite in the name of common cause. This is why the program of mutual help has been developed. Let me explain to you how it works. As we have learned from history, everybody chooses their own way to serve the Empire. Some control the monsters' population on allods, some eliminate the external threat in the Astral, some fight for the Empire in local conflicts with the League... and other enemies. All those heroes bring a part of their rewards to me and trade them for special coins, which, in their turn, can be traded for other valuables. That's a very useful initiative!

On behalf of the Free Traders, I salute you!

Let me remind you that the prices are flexible and change depending on the demand. Purchased goods are non-refundable!
Oh, is it for me? Thank you so much! Of course, I'll be there.

t:
Take a look around. What you see before you is Tequatl - the only settlement of our ancient nation. Its beauty rivals that of mandarin flowers in spring, though it cannot compare with the beauty of a city on the ruins of which it was built and whose name it bears.
Tequatl was the city of the Ancients. They were all-knowing, all-powerful and wielded great magic. The Ancients knew how to make rock come alive. They were masters of the heavens and the earth. Our small nation was like a younger sibling to them, and we lived our lives without worry. Only vague legends remain of those wonderful times.
The Ancients had a sworn enemy. A monster from the Void which cannot be described: even the words are scared of him and fall to silence. Who he was and where he came from is beyond our grasp. The Enemy was so powerful that all of the Ancients' wisdom and magic wasn't enough to protect them. Before they perished, in their dying moments the Ancients made sure to save us, their children and heirs. We have built our own Tequatl on the ruins of the great Tequatl of the Ancients. Thus began a new era for my people - an era of darkness and solitude. We dug roots and hunted mice, learned to build fires and sew simple rough garments for wear. Long were those days, and filled with sorrow. So thunderous was the Tekyans' cry of despair that the world split into two!
But everything changed when They came. The true gods appeared to our people. They have built their palace on the mountain and settled there. They taught our people to build houses, sew beautiful clothing from soft fabrics, and cook delicious food. And all they asked in return was our devotion. The gods are powerful, righteous and kind. And if you prove your faith, you too may experience their favor!

It's true, I never was a captive of Tep's. I used to be a cultist. I believed in eternal life and offered my services to Tep voluntarily. I worked on the Irdrich base since its foundation and I was one of the leading developers of the illusory web.
You can throw me into the Astral, I deserve that. Tensess is unlikely to forgive me and resurrect me again. I can only say one thing to justify myself: I'm not here because Tep ordered me. I saw what he was doing and what he was after. I repented and vowed to prevent him from ascending his throne, only I had nowhere to run. Once I knew about the Resistance on Irdrich, I fled to you right away.
Tep knows about your existence, but he's no more scared of you than he is of rats. He is arrogant, and that will ruin him. If you allow me to join the Resistance, I'll show you some weaknesses in his defenses. Together, we'll destroy the trap of illusion and stop that monster!

t:
Catherina should be fully supported in her activities. The Ambrosia has already proved its effectiveness in the field of mana engineering, and we need a constant influx of it, which means Eden is a key point for our interests.

I think Felix is a fairly experienced warrior who knows what he's doing, but their forces might be unequal. We have a small expeditionary force on our side, and theirs are the resources of their world and the goddess who created it.

 I believe you can handle this mission and provide our world with the Ambrosia.

Junes decided to side with me.
As you can imagine, Sarn got very angry! He cursed them, and that's how the first demon was born - June Curse that almost wiped the entire nation. I managed to save a bunch of people. But the only way to protect them from the Curse was changing their appearance, turning them into entirely different creatures.
Those who did not turn into Wormfaces died. Eventually the Curse weakened, and the last June managed to defeat it.
This is the whole Revelation. What happened next? Sarn made another attempt. He created a new race, the demons. And now he is using them to destroy this world completely.

So, I returned to this world.
I could just kill everyone, repair the prison that was shattered by the meteorite and forget about Sarn. But it would have been too easy. Watching over my enemy transformation was much more interesting! Do you understand? God of Light has to become a God of Darkness in order to escape!
I decided to add fuel to the fire. I told Junes everything. Told them that their God of Light was a manipulating liar!
Sarn never told them why they had to hunt the Great Dragons. He never warned them that death of the last dragon would destroy the world!
I told them everything. And I made them an offer. They could side with me and keep the world safe, or side with their Creator, and shatter it into pieces!

I'm not going to quote half-witted Tka-Rik. I'll tell you everything in my own words.
When Junes led by Sarn killed most of the Dragon Keepers, these winged beasts, who I left to protect the world, finally asked me for help. At first they hoped to destroy Sarn's children themselves, and therefore hesitated.
But they failed. They were smart enough to capture the Elves with their beauty, and that's it. They couldn't cope with Junes.
Weaklings! Since then I never rely on dragons. And the fact that the last of the Great Dragons betrayed me is just adds to the story.
r202730.n: Ask about the third part of the Revelation

t:
First thing you should know is that Draconids and Wormfaces act independently.
I think they helped each other to get to this moment, they made a deal perhaps, a temporary alliance against me... But could they forget the old feud?
Of course not. The war between Junes and the Great Dragons continues!
Especially now that they hunt for the same thing. Something that belongs to me. They hope to use it to change their fate.
What is this thing? Oh, this is a topic for another conversation...
We'll talk about it. But not now.
r202731.n: Ask about the aim of the traitors

t:
Not treachery of Draconids, no. They are just obedient servants of their master, the Great Dragon, Father of Fire, the last Dragon Keeper.
The creatures he created followed his will blindly, respected him as a god... Fools.
And as for him, he decided it was a good time to challenge me... He thinks that the power of the Seal makes him almighty!
Well, we'll see...
r202732.n: Ask about the treachery of Draconids

t:
Our allies, Wormfaces and Draconids, betrayed us.
No, they didn't side with Sarn and his demons. They have nothing to do with them.
They decided they could play their own game.
Do you remember the ritual with Spark of Osip at Gipat? Wormfaces used the same ritual to resurrect Zak. They have a leader now - Great Ath-Zak, Conqueror of June Curse! I guess he likes it more than telling stories in ghostly form. Hmm... It's understandable.
But Zak can't defeat Sarn. Fighting the curse of god is not the same as fighting the god himself.
r202733.n: Ask about the treachery of Wormfaces

t:
Ruins of the Dead City are the aim of Sarn, Zak and the Great Dragon! The thing they seek is hidden there. Funny, how this bait was intended for Sarn only, but two little fishes swallowed it too... You are going to catch them all!
Here's the plan. You will learn more later.

I can do anything. And of course, I can teleport you out of this cave if you have nothing left to do here...
Let's say goodbyes!

A source of incredible magical power, hm? Well, those Aoidoi aren’t as foolish as I thought, if they decided to hand it over to someone more experienced. Tell them I’ll be there on time.

No go, I’m very busy.
Get ready. Let’s start with someone simple, like Midnight Dweller, for example.
That didn’t even make you sweat! Alright, let’s try something more complicated.
Here you go, don’t lose it next time.

Where did you get it?! Give it to me now, I must... Oh, sorry! I'm still a little bit out of my head after that Leper disaster...

Yes, I know something about this crystal. Long ago, I saw a shard like this one. It was tiny. The man who gave it to me told me that he had found it in a wrecked ship, full with withered bodies of Zem. I suppose those were Tep cultists - those Arisen who believe in the Light would have resurrected.

My research showed that the stone was emitting an unknown energy of such an enormous power that it subjugated and altered all other known magical fields. I was trying to figure it out for a very long time and could find no proper use for it, so I decided to implement it in one of my mechanisms as an element of the stand-by energy contour. That device was left on Eclipse... Oh, no, you destroyed it in the fight with my faithful captain Krivov!
What has brought you to my chamber? Don't waste my time!
r202958.n: What has brought you to my chamber? Don't waste my time!

t: Let’s go into my chamber and talk.

You a like a child. Always pick up dirt. It’s good you’re not trying to put it in your mouth.

Everything in this land has become corrupted. Every little thing, humans, animals, trees and flowers, all turn into dread. We call this disease "Leper". Only gods know how to cure it. We’ve tried both fire and wizardry, all in vain. Even Catherina herself, the Queen of Umoir, is only able as much as to restrain it, not to turn it the other way round.

This is not a good time to visit this place...
r202974.n: You a like a child. Always pick up dirt. It’s good you’re not trying…

t:
Lisa is a little reticent about her past. She has been in our squad for a number of years, but nobody can say that they know her well. She is bitchy and hot-headed, but she is reliable as a rock. I would trust her with my life, no question! But at our first meeting we almost finished each other off!
Because of her quarrelsome nature, she threw in her studies of elf magic, quarreled with her House and left for who knows where. She wandered around the world, gaining experience. She even lived with the druids for a while! And when she got bored with her traveling, she settled in a forest hut next to a small village, and decided to earn a living as a herbalist. Everything would have been fine, but a poor harvest was followed by pestilence. And the peasants were stupid and superstitious. There was this one clever clogs, he remembered about the forest witch and blamed her for all the misfortune. The men armed themselves with sickles and scythes and went to her hut, to burn the witch... But she gave them a good hiding! They ran off so fast, you couldn't see their heels for dust. As soon as they reached their village, they thought hard. They were afraid to go back to the witch themselves. And then we wandered into the tavern. So, the villagers hired our gang to catch the god awful witch and hand over to the local authorities for a fair trial.
Aha, as if she could be caught! She met us on the approach and the whole thing almost ended in a slaughter. Luckily, everything worked out. In the end we had a heart to heart with her, and we agreed that she would leave the village with us, and then we would see. Anyway, it ended up with Lisa staying with our group. And, you know, I have never once regretted that decision. And her ability to meddle with enemies' heads has saved our skins many times!

O-o-o, Stormer is not only our best fighter. She is our lucky charm and guardian angel. She has saved our squad so many times by slashing through the surrounding enemies, I have lost count! In combat she is not a woman, but a hurricane. And you should keep away from her when she is in action, she could crush you without even noticing it.
But it wasn't so long ago that she joined us. There was this business we were involved in a few years ago. Wild Orcs had gotten into the habit of robbing a village, and we were hired to hang these robbers from the trees along the road. We hunted for that gang for a long time, we combed all the surrounding forests. We finally found the scoundrels and hemmed them into a gorge. Then their leader came out and said: "You will finish us off, but you will lose half of your squad in the process." And she challenged me to a duel. If I won, I could do with them as I wished, if I lost - then they could leave... Anyway, I won that fight. And it turned out that they were not bandits at all, but ordinary Orcs that were forced out of their native village by drought. Anyway, we let these would-be robbers go. But their leader, Stormer, decided to stay with us. And we have nobody more reliable and loyal in our squad than her.
And you should see her fight... It's a wonder to behold! So, if you are after a powerful attack, go ahead and hire Stormer!
r203033.n: O-o-o, Stormer is not only our best fighter. She is our lucky charm…

t:
If they are unlucky enough to get an elbow in the stomach, then our mercenaries have but one hope - Matron Lighthand. A wonder woman! Her methods are severe, but effective. It goes without saying, if her idea of anesthesia is to give you a whack of a crowbar on your skull!
And you should hear her curse in three languages at the same time! They say that she was thrown out of the Church of Light because of her sharp tongue. But what is that to us? She can curse all she wants, as long as she knows her business. And Stormer can curse up a storm! So, there is no point in going into combat without Matron - she heals wounds, deactivates poison, and removes curses in a flash. And she can flash past your eyes so quickly, you won't know what hit you!
r203035.n: If they are unlucky enough to get an elbow in the stomach, then our…

t:
You would have to search to find another soldier like Rowdy Brow. He started as a bouncer in some dirty tavern, then he joined the army, but he didn't stick it for long - he has a difficult character, it is not suited to army discipline. But then he is as strong as a bull, he can break horseshoes with his hands. As soon as this hulk appears on the battlefield and the enemy sees him, they don't pay attention to any other fighters. But it makes no difference to Brow - in heavy armor the blows are like mosquito bites to him. His armor is not simple, it is impregnated with meteorite iron.... if he is not lying, of course.
So, if you need a reliable defender, then you won't go wrong with Brow. True, he is a little touched in the head... He had a difficult childhood, iron toys, a harsh environment. A total redneck, in short, but he earns his contract money, down to the last penny. As he says "no cheating, or the guys won't understand".

Greetings!

We Mercenaries are not just after easy money, we are disciplined and experienced warriors, that surpass the soldiers of the imperial army by a long shot. Why? It's simple - those who prefer to earn a living with the sword and not with the plow, but do not want to feel like a square peg in a round hole, join the Mercenaries. From the point of view of the law, we are private military subcontractors that follow a special regime. We serve the Empire, but that doesn't mean that we can't make a profit. So if you need reliable, trained warriors at a reasonable price - you won't find better than us!

You can hire one Mercenary, or five if you want. So, shall we start discussing the contract?
r203037.n: Greetings! We Mercenaries are not just after easy money, we are…

Which one would you like to hire? We will help you for free!
No problem! Who exactly would you like to return from Purgatory?
r203079.n: No problem! Who exactly would you like to return from Purgatory?

t: Get ready! I'm opening the Portal!

How about the Kaboom family? They really know how to handle those cannons!

They are supposed to be on Irdrich, fighting Mechanoids. You should look there for them!
r203089.n: How about the Kaboom family? They really know how to handle those…

t:
I want to personally reward you for your glorious service. Neither Nihaz, nor the great Astral demons, nor the mutinous Gorluxor, nay, no one but me would ever grant you that which you shall receive! The most precious reward that any mortal could possibly wish for: a vial of dragon's blood, imbued with powerful sorcery.
Having imbibed a vial of this blood, you will attain powers beyond the dreams of most. That, or you will die in agony. But I know you have no fear of danger. So bottoms up, and then we'll talk some more.

Old age is not a blessing!..
Give it to me. This thing is pure evil. I will destroy it.

Catherina, Felix, and this Ivan must be stopped.

I don't know how, and I don't want to be the one whose words lead to sacrifice. However, I think these Children have every right to defend themselves. After all, this is their world, they are the masters there, and we are the guests.

Try to find Expedition members who are on your side.

Oh, Catherina. She has always been ambitious. I thought Sarn's story would be a lesson for her, but alas.

To challenge a goddess whose powers we don't even know? Start a war in a foreign world without thinking about the consequences?
r203112.n: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

r203114.n: Что же делать в этой ситуации?

t: The invitation to the Great Ball, of course. I need to see the invitation to take you to Irene. Come back when you have one. You can always find me right here.

Allow me to greet you on behalf of all elves.

Do you have the invitation?
r203122.n: Allow me to greet you on behalf of all elves. Do you have the…

t: There will be no "later"! You do realize you either hand it to us, or we'll... take it, right?
r203163.n: I'm afraid I can't do that. But later...

t: Truly? This is where our interests cross... But my mission is not that secret. I'm looking for my sister. I have reasons to believe there's a connection between her and Eurial. You have probably found something inside – give it to us, and you can leave.
r203164.n: I'm here on a secret mission I can't talk about.

t: How would I know? I haven't been there. But the place is packed right now, so with your talents you'll be able to get lost in the crowd. You'll figure out the rest.
Only those who are dressed in a certain way and have a key! What are you bothering me with this? Bring me something to drink...
Ah, that's wise! You can go anywhere, there are no secrets. Just stay away from the door guarded by the lamia - it's a private zone, only for the best customers, like me...
r203202.n: It's my first time here, I don't want any trouble.

t: Ahhh! You're not the only one... Now go... Bring me some wine...
r203203.n: I'm a secret admirer of Eurial and would like to know everything about her...

t: I see you're off your rocker! Go away... And come back with wine...
r203204.n: I'm a spy looking for secret information!

t: Hmm... Why do you need to know? I don't like weirdos...
r203205.n: Do you know any places that should be avoided?

r203207.n: Could you give me your clothes?

t: What now? I don't carry it on me – because of people like you...
r203209.n: Could you give me your key?

t: So boring... Just standing next to you makes me feel drowsy.
r203216.n: It's my first time here, I don't want any trouble.

r203217.n: I'm a secret admirer of Eurial and would like to know everything about her...

t: It's for trusted people, like me! You can't get in without a special outfit and a key!
Aah, I knew it, haha! Go wherever you want, just avoid that door guarded by the lamia. It's a special place...
r203219.n: Of course! I'm a spy looking for secret information!

t: The edge of the allod! Why? Are you spying on us?
r203220.n: Do you know any places that should be avoided?

t: I like tricks! I won't give you my clothes, of course, but I left another set in my secret stash at the top of the main building – a spare one in case I fall in the water or something, haha!
r203221.n: Yes, I want to trick my friend so he thinks I'm someone else!

r203222.n: I'm a spy, it's a disguise!

t: You need a couturier, it's not something I do!
r203223.n: I want to try it on

t: Wow! What is this, a role-playing gag?
r203224.n: Could you give me your clothes?

t: I went on a bender a while ago, must have dropped it somewhere... Could you look around, please?
I can't imagine why you'd want it! But maybe I could use your help with that...
r203226.n: Could you give me your key?

t: Yes? I did lose mine, but... Hm... I found another one... Listen, throw this one away, and forget all about it!
Trouble... Life without trouble is boring!
r203231.n: It's my first time here, I don't want any trouble.

t: You need to be dressed a certain way – it's what Eurial's trusted people wear. Like me, for example.
I know what you mean! I understand... There is a special place – the door guarded by the lamia, but I doubt they will let you in...
r203233.n: I'm a secret admirer of Eurial and would like to know everything about her...

r203234.n: Of course! I'm a spy looking for secret information!

r203235.n: Do you know any places that should be avoided?

t: Hmm... While I understand why you might need that, I can't help you. Sorry.
r203236.n: Could you give me your clothes?

t: Sorry, but this is not some game!
r203237.n: I want to see what's behind that secret door!

t: How sweet! For love, I'll pretend I've lost my key – it won't be the first time!
r203238.n: I want to know more about my beloved, Eurial...

r203239.n: I don’t know, perhaps we could become closer?

t: Oh, well. Maybe? I don't know. I found one just recently, but... Why do you need it?
r203240.n: Could you give me your key?

t: The northern districts are not ready to receive guests. Come back later! I'll take you there.

Oh please, me and Yasker have known each other for a while. In 957, he occupied Ignis... They even made a... what was it... a “motion picture” about it. Of course, it wasn’t accurate.

What matters is he’s willing to listen.
r203295.n: You were secretly negotiating with Yasker?! How could you?

t:
I’m glad you understand. I’ve known Yasker a long time. In 957, he occupied Ignis... They even made a... what was it... a “motion picture” about it. Of course, it wasn’t accurate.

But it laid the ground for negotiation. Just don’t tell Rysina. She can’t know about this.
r203296.n: It’s good that someone still strives for peace.

t:
Louis wants everyone to get along!

But Renard has gone too far. House de Delice has the right to do what they think is necessary. I admit we shouldn’t have made Iris a mediator between me and Yasker... But we should be able to negotiate freely.
r203297.n: The king is asking me to settle your disputes.

t: I knew Renard had a hand in this. It’s outrageous.
r203298.n: I knew Renard had a hand in this. It’s outrageous.

t: What can she do? She has no House, no family, she’s just a bastard or unwanted child of some nameless performers. I have everything under control.
r203301.n: I hope you know what you are doing and the snake in your bosom won’t bite at the worst…

t: My dear friend, you’re spending too much time with Imelda de Luner! What connections, what horrible things? It’s nothing uncommon among the Great Houses. She’s probably a lovechild of de Vevre and Grandeur. Or do you think Nihaz has a hand in this, too? Discuss this with Elhe de Doucer. She could use another source of inspiration, and your tales should do splendidly.
r203302.n: Eurial is dangerous! She might have powerful connections that are plotting horrible…

t: It’s possible, that’s why I have her watched, too. I can’t trust anyone in this business. Even myself, haha!
r203303.n: Don’t you think Eurial’s playing her own game?

t:
She was a mediator between her mother and the Empire. Antoinette’s life is in the open, but her disgraced and exiled daughter won’t surprise anyone if she starts hanging around seedy areas, looking for adventures.

Admittedly, we didn’t suspect her right away. Only Eurial managed to bring Iris’s affairs to light.
r203304.n: What was Iris’s role in this?

t: Of course! We’ve been watching her for a while. When I say “we”, I mean the League, of course. Pavel Isaev is very interested in the affairs of the House de Delice! We have finally exposed them.
r203305.n: So you were right, and Antoinette was indeed negotiating with Yasker, trying to arrange…

t: As expected, the dirty dancing of our archduchess is no longer a secret. I see you can’t wait to hear everything.
r203306.n: As expected, the dirty dancing of our archduchess is no longer a…

t: Nothing. My spy career is over, so I’ll spend my days like my sisters, in blissful idleness. Though perhaps I’ll join Gala in her diplomatic work, rescuing vampires, werewolves, demons, and other unfortunate souls.
r203309.n: What are you going to do now that you’re back at the Court?

t:
Yes, listen carefully: Eurial is not who she says she is. I know she recently visited both House de Grandeur and House de Vevre. Do you know what they have in common? They both once lived on Grok.

There it is. I’ve learned that soon after the Cataclysm, she went there with her parents. She was a young girl then, but there was already something intimidating about her. No one but the Great Mage Claud de Vevre knew who they were, but the locals gave an accurate description. They lived in his Tower for a while, and then simply vanished.
r203310.n: Weren’t you afraid of returning to the Court because of some conspiracy?

t:
What else could I do?

After my escape, I still had some connections over there, so I was able to bypass the Committee and contact Yasker’s people directly.

They wouldn’t have caught me if I hadn’t taken an interest in that viper Eurial. She’s clever. Spotted the tail quickly and struck back. I don't know who she is but she’s clearly someone to fear.
r203311.n: Were you actually a mediator between Antoinette and the Empire?

t: No, though I had to spend a while in that monastery on Lumenara... I was afraid that viper would poison me, but the only real threat was boredom. All they do there is pray, read pious books, and sing in a choir...
r203312.n: There I am. Did they hurt you?

t: Yes... People will be angry. But we shouldn’t blame the vampires. This is a difficult time for them, too. People should know that Annette and the others are fighting Nihaz for our world!
r203317.n: Our chances aren’t good, especially after Renard tells everyone about the negotiations…

t: I’m glad you believe in us! We need to win, and people should know that Annette and the others are fighting Nihaz for our world! Maybe we should make a speech in their defense.
r203318.n: I believe the odds are in favor of the House de Delice.

t: Phew, I’m glad you’re not holding a grudge. I wouldn’t want us to fall out after what happened on Umoir. Besides, I might need your help. Do you think we can win?
r203319.n: Let bygones be bygones... I’m sorry, too.

t:
Yes, it was a close call...

…

Listen, about what happened at the residence of that viper... I’m sorry it got to that. But you have to understand - we were worried about Iris’s disappearance, and we had no other leads.
r203320.n: I’m glad your sister is alright.

t:
Love knows no bounds!

Lucretia is a delicate flower among all the weeds. Intrigues weigh heavily on her, and she longs for adventures. I got her attention with stories of my feats, and she showed me a lot... in the art of love.

I heard many Leaguers are tired of the war... And I personally know those who became close with someone they had only seen through the eye-slit of their visor before. So it shouldn't surprise you.
r203357.n: Elven queen and Imperial general? And you're a couple?

t:
I needed it because we were going to the Dragon Bay. The skeleton of one of the Great Dragons is buried there, along with the never-dying heart, the source of dragon blood. The Bond is the artifact used by the Great Mages of elves to bind dragons and collect their blood... It's quite a useful thing...

The Empire needs new Great Mages, so a new source of this blood would come in handy.

I know the League sent an expedition to Ferris, too, but it's the Empire's territory! Any speculation about it being a part of ancient Isa is irrelevant.
r203358.n: Why did you need the artifact?

t:
Love knows no bounds!

Lucretia is a delicate flower among all the weeds. Intrigues weigh heavily on her, and she longs for adventures. I got her attention with stories of my feats, and she showed me a lot... in the art of love.

At any rate, I didn't betray my homeland. Everything I do serves a purpose. I want there to be peace between the League and Empire. The Empire really needs peace right now.
r203359.n: So how did you, an Imperial general, come to know the elven queen?

The Empire needs new Great Mages, so a new source of this blood would come in handy.

And Ferris is the Empire's territory. As an Imperial citizen, you might agree with me...

r203361.n: What a beast! It's a miracle we escaped.

t: Oh Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan... Everything hurts...!
r203362.n: Oh Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan... Everything hurts...!

We always meet with our informers somewhere we won't draw attention: in a theatre, in a square in the northern district, in the garden near the palace, in the middle of the main street, near a brothel, or at the lake at the Secluded Sanctuary. If you forget this again...
r203376.n: Could you remind me where our meeting points are?

t: Is this your first time? I think I've seen you before... Hmm. You'll recognize them easily - by their carnival mask. Or should I also tell you what an informer does?

Find our informer. He'll give you the information and tell you who it's meant for. But be careful: sometimes Irene intelligence replaces our informers with their agents, and if they catch you, they'll know you're one of us. Remember: our informers never carry a weapon.

But if you were, say, a double agent, you could still tell them everything and get what you need... What was I talking about?
One of us. Great. I have a job for you.

r203434.n: I want to accept House de Ardeur Patronage

t:
House de Ardeur is one of the greatest elven Houses. We achieved much, both in glorifying the Lights and in engineering, making a fine example for other Great Houses. Mirage and Galleon Castle are our inventions. Our leaders, Renard and Marianne, are the Heads of the Church of Light of All Elves.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

A unique Ruby Gryphon of an untold beauty.

Our House servants are brave Aviaks. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Triss de Ardeur will join you. She's our youngest and most talented engineer, who will overcome Celestine one day.

We produce excellent tools for disassembling astral materials. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.
r203435.n: I want to know more about House de Ardeur patronage

It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

r203437.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

t: Then here's her calling card. You have probably seen these already – all Houses on Irene use them. Special magic will allow your companion to instantly teleport to you anywhere on Irene – just take it in your hands and read the name on it! If you read the name again, your companion will return to the residence!

Considering all your accomplishments and certain circumstances... Yes, there's someone who can't wait to explore everything around here. Her interests seem to align with yours. She has managed to wear us all out, I hope you'll help her channel her energy into something productive. If this is agreeable to you, I believe she'll be ready in no time. So what do you say? Does it suit you?

r203441.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

r203442.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

t: That's great. I hope we'll have fun together!
r203443.n: Yes, I want to part with my current companion.

t:
My House is famous for our knowledge of magic, not in theory, but purely in practice. Our interests lie in the field of alchemy, the queen of magical sciences. There's no waving a magic wand and shouting incantations. Only a strong mind can comprehend it. Almost all popular recipes of elven potions are developed by the specialists of our House.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are skilled mountainfolk. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Rosan de Blizare will join you. He's a talented alchemist, who will gain his combat experience with you.

Besides, we know how to synthesize the Unsteady Matter, which will come in handy if you want to reforge your armor. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.
r203453.n: I want to know more about House de Blizare patronage

t: Yes, this is his calling card. Everyone uses them on Irene, even other Houses. As soon as you read the name on it, he will immediately appear next to you. If you read it again, the companion will leave you.

Hmm... Yes, it's possible. Actually, it would be a good thing! There is... an interesting young man. We are proud of people like him – young geniuses, but he could certainly benefit from being more... sociable. A member of a Great House should be recognized in social circles! He has a lot of respect for you, so you are probably our only chance to get him to take a walk around Irene. Are you interested?
r203458.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

t: You already have Rosan from our House with you.
r203459.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

r203460.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

What an interesting and timely desire! Yes, the best member of our House has been dreaming of exploring Irene with you! Take her with you!

t:
Our House is famous for the interest in magic. Magic is more than a craft for us. Magic is our whole life. Our House has the biggest number of magisters and acolytes. The main elven magic school is located on our home allod. The young mages begin their studies in a very young age. Apart from everything else, we shine in theoretical and practical magic.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are crafty lamias. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Grim de Grandeur will join you. He's a young mage with very unusual ideas. He'd like to test them, and you are going to help him.

Our magic allows us to create small amounts of Dust of Creation, a unique ingredient used for crafting of powerful artifacts. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

t: House de Desirae, one of the most ancient Houses, was related to the last royal House of Irene, which enabled Margo de Desirae, the mother of the king, to declare herself the queen. That was when the other Houses arrogantly decided to elect the ruling House at the Great Ball. House de Desirae won several times. We connect our current success with Prince Dakkar. He rekindled the popularity of necromancy among elves, and Conclave lifted the ban! Some unpleasant events took place after that Ball. House de Doucer violated the rules of the Great Game. Our House couldn't leave it unattended! You know about the consequences.

How, you ask? You will have to find that out once you take to the air.

You can purchase the mask from me, but it will only start working once you have gained a friendly reputation with the House de Pluie.

Although, if you don't have the mask yet, I can lend you one for this task.

Besides, House de Pluie is hosting the best artists, sculptors, and jewelers. Their works grant our superiority in the market.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are mighty minotaurs. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Ellia de Pluie will join you - a young entrepreneur, who can help you earn money on this allod.

We purchased a big batch of chests with various crafting materials you can choose from. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.

Now listen carefully. The bad news is we don't know where the general is going exactly. And there's no time to find that out.

The good news is we know the local teleportation master, Sarang Ashturi. She has spent years on Ferris – she should know a little about everything that takes place there.

The second good news is Ivok's perception and Potis's eyesight. Ferris's landscapes are too... Vast for you to be able to find any traces on your own. So if you find out where the general was headed, listen to them.

t: I have a very important meeting, and there will be attempts to disrupt it even here, so this disguise is not enough. I asked you for help, because your company won't draw attention, and if things go south, you can protect me. And also because you won't ask too many questions. So, are we going? We don’t have much time.
I'll tell you after the meeting.

This shard is called Secluded Sanctuary. The name fits. People rarely come here – only when they seek solitude. It's a great place for secret royal meetings, if you disregard the complete lack of guards.

They say special magic dwells here – whatever the cause, no one has found an explanation for the local lake's infinite supply of water which flows to the beautiful canals in the city and the river in our forest.

I didn't want to alarm the queen, but I think someone was watching us from the windows of the next building... I hope I'm wrong, but we need to be careful. I don't think her date... Oh, I mean meeting, will take much time.

t:
No specific instructions – you have to feel it in your heart! To make it less complicated, I will approve of your correct behavior and disapprove of bad one. Know that I assess your every move, and the more elegant gestures you use to express yourself, the better!

But all in all... Enjoy your evening! Try some wine or engage someone in conversation.

Just don't speak with Solemna de Ardeur – you won't hear anything good from her, that's for sure.
Turning uncouth heroes into dignified young people! We, the House de Grandeur, will do everything in our power to make sure you do not embarrass yourselves at the royal reception.

You heroes never do anything for free! What about invaluable social skills?

...Fine, of course we reward those who make an effort. I'll be watching you, and you can come get your reward at any time. But remember: the greater the effort, the better the reward!

You can get your reward either during the lesson by talking to me, or we'll reward you afterwards along with everyone else.

I'll back you up so no one will throw you out early. Just make sure to give it your everything.
